name: MultiEval
tagline: Measures, compares, debugs and automatically evolves multi-agent orchestration patterns.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Multi-agent systems fail through coordination, and tracing tools built for single agents cannot show it.
solution: Built on Inspect AI and OpenHands: a graph and Gantt trace viewer for delegation, statistically bounded A/B comparison of harnesses, and a meta-agent loop that proposes, benchmarks and iterates harness variants under a budget.
demo_moment: Team-described: a structured-delegation harness lifts pass rate from 0.79 to 0.87 against a baseline, with the lift shown as significant.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” and “Cognition Company Challenge” among 307 submissions.
Treats orchestration patterns as something to measure, like model architectures.
Reports confidence bounds instead of a single score.

lessons: Statistics on your own eval make an infrastructure demo believable.
